work.title: Innovation & Strategic Partnerships Intern
description: Produced strategic partner reports, conducted market analysis for Visa Ventures AP, and supported stakeholder engagement through major events such as the Singapore Fintech Festival.

items.title: 1st Runner-up, Shopee Ultra Hackathon
items.summary: Built a standalone mobile application prototype within 36 hours, integrating Shopee's APIs to deliver new engagement-focused user experiences. Designed and engineered the app using React Native and secured 1st runner-up among 96 competing teams.

items.title: Champion, Build On, ASEAN 2021 Singapore
items.summary: Led a team of 5 to develop a telehealth solution for pregnant mothers, delivering a React and AWS web application with integrated machine learning features in 2 weeks. Organised by AWS and TechForShe.

items.title: Semi-Finalist, Adobe Analytics Challenge 2020
items.summary: Emerged as top 20 teams amongst 1,600 teams globally by constructing and pitching data-driven recommendations derived from large-scale real-world data using Adobe Analytics.

items.title: Building a Suicidal Text Detection Model and Mental Health Chatbot
items.summary: Finetuned classifier guardrails attaining a 97% F1 score and integrated the model into a DialoGPT chatbot.

items.title: Detecting Adverse Drug Events with Deep Neural Models
items.summary: Researching on joint entity and relation extraction models and with new representation learning techniques through the integration of knowledge graphs.

items.title: Predicting Flu Trends using Twitter Data
items.summary: Built a flu-trend prediction proof-of-concept by scraping Twitter data, developing NLP classifiers (80% F1), achieving a 68% correlation with ground-truth trends, and deploying a live monitoring dashboard on SAP Analytics Cloud.
